title: AntiFan FixResult v2
description: Schema for machine-readable fix results returned by the builder-fixer worker or emitted by the merge-gate audit in AntiFan B-Lite v2

decision.description: Typed audit or worker decision code

touchedPaths.description: List of relative file paths within stagedRoot that were created, modified, or deleted (|T|)

budgets.description: Actual budget usage measured across touched files

bytes.description: Total bytes of net change across touched files

expandedPaths.description: List of files touched that were not in requestedTargets (T \ R). Count must not exceed maxScopeExpansion.

missingPaths.description: Files needed for the repair that were absent from allowedFiles, populated during SCOPE_DISCOVERY

toolSurface.description: Tools invoked by the fixer worker during the attempt. Permitted: file.read, file.write.

selfVerificationClaimed.description: Must be false. Any fixer claim of self-verification triggers an immediate REFUSED_SELF_VERIFICATION failure.

notes.description: Explanation of changes made, or rationale for refusal / scope discovery
